question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place where antiques are kept
solution:
The correct answer is **Museum**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Museum: **​a building where collections of valuable and interesting objects are kept and shown to the public.
